name: Open LLM — AngelOS
author: futureUnd1ground
description: Открытые LLM в AngelOS: чат через ангела и демона, скачивание локальных моделей, агент с инструментами рабочего стола и MCP.
dependencies: zstd for optional local Ollama installation (x86_64)
Ollama (installable in the plugin) or an OpenAI-compatible model server
permissions: Network access to the model endpoint selected by the user
Read desktop state through AngelOS IPC and niri
Apply explicit or user-enabled automatic AngelOS actions
Store endpoint-specific API keys in a private local credential file
Download an official verified Ollama runtime and user-selected model weights on explicit request
